title: selfcheck's host check, and the review's done before its whole-suite run, name a host too loaded for the suite to meet its seconds ceiling
goal: selfcheck's host check fails, and a review story's done says so before it starts the whole suite, when the host's load would put a whole-suite tests.py run over the darwin seconds ceiling; seen in the SP-wwacrsqr review, where selfcheck passed at a 5-minute load near 10 on 14 cores (under LOAD_PER_CORE 1.5) while another application held the CPU, and the review's done then ran the suite for 168 s against the 22 s ceiling and refused after three minutes (SP-wwacrsqr retrospective).
